title: AI in Telecoms: Trends and Consumer Impact
discussion_signal: Ofcom’s discussion frames AI as a new intermediary in telecoms customer journeys: consumers may use it to compare or manage services, but mixed views about human support and scepticism about automated assistance keep accountable access central.
linked_research_question: How do consumers use AI as a telecoms-market intermediary while retaining demand for human support and accountable access?
limits: The post summarizes a discussion paper rather than measuring long-run adoption
It does not establish whether AI improves consumer outcomes
UK telecoms regulation and market structure limit generalization
